description: This is a Java source file defining the BillingAccountWorker class, which contains utility methods for managing billing accounts, including fetching balances, calculating available amounts, and retrieving open orders.

classes.name: BillingAccountWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to handle billing account calculations and queries in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makePartyBillingAccountList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of billing accounts related to a party, considering account balances and limits.

methods.name: getBillingAccountOpenOrders
methods.description: Fetches open orders associated with a billing account, excluding completed, canceled, or rejected orders.

methods.name: getBillingAccountAvailableBalance
methods.description: Calculates how much balance is available for charging on a billing account, considering account limits and current balances.

methods.name: getBillingAccountNetBalance
methods.description: Computes the net balance of a billing account based on applied payments and invoices, excluding canceled invoices.

methods.name: availableToCapture
methods.description: Determines the amount available for capture on a billing account, which is account limit minus the net balance.

methods.name: calcBillingAccountBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns a set of billing account details, including balances and limits, suitable for use in services.
